name: Blue Mode: Cleanup Sweep
what: Final cleanup sweep after verification passes. Removes debug artifacts, temp files, console.logs, TODO comments from fixed code, and ensures no pollution remains. Cleans the bug off the shoe.
when_to_use: When closing out a feature or fix cycle
when_not_to_use: On active development branches (would remove useful debug code)
philosophy: Leave no trace. The system should be cleaner after we leave than when we arrived. Debug artifacts, temporary hacks, and leftover comments pollute the codebase over time. Blue Mode ensures a clean final state.

finds: Generated files that shouldn't be committed

constraints: Only clean files touched in this workflow
Never remove debug code from unrelated files
Preserve intentional TODO comments (only remove ones from fixed bugs)

required: List of files modified in Fix wave

examples.input: 8 files touched by Fix wave, Green Mode passed
examples.output: Removed 3 console.logs, 2 TODO comments, 1 commented block. CLEAN.

metrics.success_criteria: Zero debug artifacts in modified files
